# Stella Maynard

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** Vancouver  <sub>[v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher and college student  <sub>[v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

Stella Maynard is a vivid, black-eyed girl who is considered one of the beauties of her class. She is described as being rose-red and rosy-cheeked, with hair that is darker than Anne's.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c1 P21](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0021)_

## Personality

Stella possesses a heartful of wistful dreams and rainbow-like fancies, though she can occasionally feel discouraged or gloomy about her studies and life's outlook. She dislikes boarding and yearned for a home-like environment while attending college. She is ambitious enough to pursue a university degree after years of country teaching, but remains a warm and intimate friend to her college housemates.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c35 P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 c35 P35](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0035)_

## Abilities

- Teaching school  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## Goals

- To obtain a B.A. degree at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- To set up a housekeeping establishment at Patty's Place with her friends and aunt  <sub>[v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>

## History

Stella Maynard attended Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Priscilla Grant, completing her third year before taking up a career as a country schoolteacher. Finding the repetitive complaints of parents, the multi-grade duties, and the loneliness of boardinghouses tedious, she resolved to quit teaching and pursue a degree at Redmond College. She proposed renting a furnished house in Kingsport where she, Anne, Priscilla, and Philippa Gordon could live together, bringing her aunt, Jamesina, to act as housekeeper. During their time at Patty's Place, Stella managed the household accounts and participated in the social life and academic rivalries of Redmond, successfully completing her course work and graduating alongside her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001), [v3 c16 P11](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0011), [v3 c37 P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029)_
